menu_infamy_desc_root_new:
As a new to the criminal elite, the first order of business is for you to get gear and fanfare befitting someone of your status.

BONUSES:
Your infamous base drop rate is increased from ##0.3%## to ##0.6%##.
Experience gained is increased by ##5%##.
bm_equipment_doctor_bag_desc: To use the Doctor Bag, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved, but it can be used by you and your crew by holding $BTN_INTERACT; to regain health. Using the doctor bag will give the player one life back, meaning the player can get downed once more before going into custody. It can only be used twice.$NL;$NL;When the Doctor Bag is consumed, it disappears. You can see how many uses are left by looking at the Doctor Bag. $NL;$NL;The Doctor Bag is a portable bag, usually used by a physician or other medical profession to transport medical supplies and medicine.
bm_equipment_grenade_case_desc: To use the Grenade Case, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved, but it may be used by both you and your crew by holding $BTN_INTERACT; to restore throwables. It can fully replenish your grenade reserves 4 times. When the Grenade Case is depleted, it disappears. You can see how many uses are left by looking at the Grenade Case. $NL;$NL;The Grenade Case is a portable case carried by combat operatives to transport explosives and other throwable weapons into a battle zone.
bm_equipment_grenade_crate_desc: To use the Ordnance Bag, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved, but it may be used by both you and your crew by holding $BTN_INTERACT; to restore throwables. It can fully replenish your grenade reserves 4 times. When the Ordnance Bag is depleted, it disappears. You can see how many uses are left by looking at the Ordnance Bag. $NL;$NL;The Ordnance Bag is a portable bag carried by combat operatives to transport explosives and other throwable weapons into a battle zone.
bm_equipment_ecm_jammer_desc: To use the ECM Jammer, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved and it will be active for 20 seconds.$NL;$NL;The ECM Jammer can be used to open certain electronic doors.$NL;$NL;The ECM Jammer will delay pagers while active.$NL;$NL;You can toggle the ECM Jammer by pressing $BTN_INTERACT;. The ECM Jammer then has a chance to incapacitate your enemies within a certain radius. When consumed, it stops working.$NL;$NL;An Electronic Countermeasure (ECM) is an electronic device designed to trick radar, sonar and other detection systems, easing your way towards your goal.
bm_concussion_desc: If the cops can throw infinite amounts of these to burn your retinas out, so should you! $NL;Although yours come in limited supply.. $NL;They may not like the taste of their own medicine, but it is their opinion and your choice! $NL;$NL;Upon detonation, they will stun anyone nearby (including you and teammates!) for a short moment. $NL;$NL;Best used indoors.
bm_grenade_sticky_grenade_desc: A grenade that explode on impact with the surfaces or enemies.
bm_grenade_poison_gas_grenade_desc: This highly-illegal grenade will emit a sweeping cloud of toxic gas that melt enemies lungs. Also will destroy your and teammates respiratory systems too if you decide to stay inside the cloud without mask protection.
